original_bug_description: A heap-use-after-free exists in libxml2's error reporting: xmlParserPrintFileContextInternal (error.c) can read from parser input pointers that reference freed heap memory when invoked via xmlReportError/__xmlRaiseError. This results in reads of deallocated memory during parsing (e.g., while handling entities or external subsets), leading to crashes or other undefined behavior and potentially enabling exploitation.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5128529790238720: libxml2 has a reported memory-safety bug. A heap-use-after-free exists in libxml2's error reporting: xmlParserPrintFileContextInternal (error.c) can read from parser input pointers that reference freed heap memory when invoked via xmlReportError/__xmlRaiseError. This results in reads of deallocated memory during parsing (e.g., while handling entities or external subsets), leading to crashes or other undefined behavior and potentially enabling exploitation.
